title: WaterSound 97 S Founders Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Beachfront in WaterSound- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Elevator- Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $65 per day**- Golf Cart- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- 6 Adult Bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout- This property come with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Lavish beach living awaits at 97 S. Founders Lane, a beachfront property accommodating 14 guests in unparalleled comfort with 6 bedrooms, 5 full bathrooms, and 4 half baths between the Carriage and Main Houses. Enjoy access to WaterSound’s Puttering Park, community pools, and multiple boardwalks. Made for sun-soaked leisure, guests will love the private pool, Gulf vistas, and beach access—only a short stroll away!The Main House’s first level features a sofa room with a 75” TV. Outside, discover an outdoor kitchen and refreshing pool with a swim-up bar. Retire to 2 lovely bedrooms, each with a king bed, TV, and access to a screened porch—1 bedroom includes 2 twin sleeper chairs.An airy yet cozy great room welcomes guests on the second level. The whitewashed tongue-and-groove ceiling, dark hardwood floors, and French doors nod to the coastal cottage design. A farmhouse table for 8 awaits savory seafood dinners and lively brunches, crafted in the chef’s kitchen boasting Wolf appliances and a spacious island seating 5. Wander through the open archways to unwind on the living space’s slip-covered sofa and armchairs. For entertainment, the TV ascends out of the ornate cabinets at the push of a button. When the coastal breeze beckons, enjoy either the balcony beside the kitchen with a 4-person table or the porch off the living space with cushioned seating—both feature dune views and glimpses of the Gulf. Down the hall is a guest bedroom featuring a king bed and private bathroom, alongside an office space that connects to a furnished deck.The stunning third-floor primary bedroom features a king bed, picturesque dune and beach views. On this level, there is also a kid-friendly guest bedroom with 4 twin beds.Follow the curving staircase to enjoy sweeping, panoramic Gulf views from the observation tower, complete with plush sofas and a beach-facing balcony.In the Carriage House, find a queen bed, king sleeper sofa, kitchenette, seating area, TV, and private bathroom.Experience coastal living at its finest at 97 S Founders Lane in WaterSound. Beach access is a short stroll away down the boardwalk behind the home. Guests also enjoy on-site parking, 6 complimentary adult bikes, and a 4-passenger low speed vehicle for convenient exploration. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Two Twin Sleepers, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Half BathroomTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Four Twin Beds- Half BathroomCARRIAGE HOUSE: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with King Sleeper, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyIMPORTANT INFORMATION* The fireplace is not for guest use.* To ensure a comfortable stay for all guests, pets are not permitted in this home. Please note that any damage caused by pets will be the guest's responsibility.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and management.*No Smoking*Ice maker is not for guest use
